designationHistory.name: Culebra Reservation
designationHistory.indexText: President Theodore Roosevelt established the Culebra Reservation by Executive Order 1042; it is now Culebra National Wildlife Refuge.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Culebra National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
Wikisource transcription of Executive Order 1042 (Feb. 27, 1909): Establishment of a Bird Reservation on the Island of Culebra, Porto Rico
Theodore Roosevelt, A Book-Lover's Holidays in the Open (1916), Appendix B: list of bird reservations created by executive order, with dates

USFWS, 508 Culebra National Wildlife Refuge Comprehensive Conservation Plan (ServCat 169388): "In 1909, portions of the Culebra Archipelago were designated as a wildlife reserve in accordance with an Executive Order signed by President Theodore Roosevelt"

review.note: EO 1042, 1909-02-27 (Theodore Roosevelt). Draft gave 1983, the year on-site refuge administration began (CCP), not the establishment.
